Combined participant edits cannot remove active OWNER/prior manager. compatibility: No schema or dependency changes. Changed manager requires exact baseUpdatedAt409 if absent/stale; scalar managerId validation400. Receiptv1 retained; sensitive manager stays global/server blacklist and only explicit adapter handles it.
rollback: Pause changed-manager commands instead of restoring generic manager assignment. Reverse only task diff; preserve current memberships/audits/receipts. No automatic history bulk rewrite.
